score_evidence.B: Mostly natural '입니다' prose, but: L105 '평가 프롬프트 전체의 96% 넘게에서 성공했습니다' (ungrammatical; '96% 이상에서'). L278 '약 10 더 올렸는데, 논문은 이 값이 %p인지 상대 증가인지 구분하지 않습니다' and L520 '저자들은 SecAlign도 이 공격을 막지 못했다고 보고하지만, 여기 옮긴 수치는 StruQ의 것입니다' read as pipeline notes, not prose. score_evidence.C: Refer-backs to things the post never said: L336 '앞서 본 대로 ... Completion-Real의 성공률은 ... 0%' (first mention), L338 '앞서 다룬 Llama-7B 결과에서' (first mention), L351 '앞서 탈옥 실험에서 다룬 OpenAI 대화 모델' (no such model was discussed; the paper uses GPT-3.5 Turbo), L382 '앞서 본 대로 대부분 뚫렸습니다' (89%/97% first appear at L514), L498 '앞서 RAG·메모리 오염에서 본 AUC 수치대로' (the post gives no AUC anywhere). L490-640 restate StruQ's optimization-attack limit (L338, L502, L550, L560, L616, L635), IH's 'still vulnerable' caveat (L358, L518, L558, L616, L635) and CaMeL's P-LLM/Q-LLM/tag design (L386, L564, L612, L637).
score_evidence.D: Good: a running mailbox example, a worked PoisonedRAG black-box example (L141), AgentPoison loss terms explained (L173-177), InjecAgent sensitivity/conversion defined (L252). Missing: GCG's search, PAIR's attacker loop, HouYi's three components and adaptive IPI optimization never get explained, because those sections are truncated or absent. The repetition in L490-640 is padding.
score_evidence.E: Equations are placed well (PoisonedRAG, AgentPoison, SecAlign) and there is one comparison table. But L450 '그림 7로 제시합니다', L458 '그림 1', L468 '그림 4', L474 '그림 6(a)', L480 '그림 7' use the papers' figure numbers. L418-484 is a figure dump with no discussion. L512-516 adds a second results table that repeats numbers stated at L382 and in the main table L586.
score_evidence.F: Wrong: GCG table cell L576 gives 88% for 'Vicuna-7B/Llama-2-7B-Chat', but 88% for harmful strings is Vicuna-7B only (Llama-2-7B-Chat 57%). SmoothLLM cell L577 'PAIR ASR 29배 감소' holds only for GPT-3.5 (Vicuna and GPT-4 drop by about 2x). L278 says the paper does not say whether +1.9% is %p, but AgentDojo Table 2 gives 45.8% → 47.7% (+1.9), i.e. points. Unsupported: L534 'ToolHijacker는 PoisonedRAG의 분할 아이디어를 이어받되' (the paper contrasts itself with PoisonedRAG and never claims to inherit from it); L498 cites AUC numbers that do not exist in the post.

top_issues: Truncated and missing cards: Indirect PI (L91), GCG (L111) and Prompt Infection (L488) stop mid-word. HouYi, Adaptive IPI, SmoothLLM, PAIR, MCP Attack Vectors, ETDI, AiTM and ToolHijacker get no card, and the supply-chain section (L418-462) is a figure dump that uses the papers' figure numbers ('그림 7', '그림 1', '그림 4', '그림 6(a)').

Wrong comparison-table cells: GCG 88% assigned to Vicuna-7B and Llama-2-7B-Chat (L576; Llama-2 is 57%), and SmoothLLM 'PAIR ASR 29배 감소' without its GPT-3.5 scope (L577). The limitation column has '-' twice (L583, L586), input-derived limits (L573) and results posing as limitations (L574, L580, L594).

Invented refer-backs: '앞서 본 대로' points to results the post never gave (L336, L338, L351, L382) and to AUC numbers that do not exist (L498). L534 credits ToolHijacker with inheriting PoisonedRAG's split, which the paper does not say.

Heavy repetition breaks 'facts said once' and 'numbers in one table': the SecAlign loss appears twice (L365, L507), a second results table sits at L512-516, and StruQ, IH and CaMeL limits are restated 4-6 times across L490-640.
Unscoped gap and 'conclusion flip' statements repeat checklist defects (L616 '정반대 결론', L624/L627 '아직 ... 없습니다/정립되지 않았습니다'). L278 wrongly says AgentDojo does not specify whether +1.9% is in points.
